business_rules.name: Tenant isolation
business_rules.description: A user, integration, or AI agent may access only records belonging to an authorized tenant.
business_rules.condition: actor tenant scope contains record tenant

business_rules.name: Permission deny precedence
business_rules.description: An explicit deny overrides any allow at the same or broader applicable scope.

business_rules.name: Least privilege default
business_rules.description: New users receive no business permissions until assigned an approved role.
business_rules.action: Permit sign-in only to onboarding or access-request surfaces
business_rules.exception: Tenant template may add approved baseline role

business_rules.name: One active policy version
business_rules.description: Only one policy version may be active for the same policy key, scope, and effective period.

business_rules.name: Approval independence
business_rules.description: A requester cannot approve their own request when dual control is required.

business_rules.name: Delegation boundary
business_rules.description: Delegated authority cannot exceed the delegator's permissions, amount, scope, or expiration.

business_rules.name: Suspension effect
business_rules.description: Suspending a user revokes active sessions and prevents new authentication.

business_rules.name: Legal hold precedence
business_rules.description: An active legal hold prevents purge regardless of ordinary retention expiration.

business_rules.name: Configuration precedence
business_rules.description: Effective configuration resolves from user, project, office, company, tenant, platform, using only override-enabled keys.

business_rules.name: Audit immutability
business_rules.description: Audit events cannot be edited or deleted through ordinary application workflows.

business_rules.name: Break-glass duration
business_rules.description: Emergency access expires at the earlier of policy maximum or approved expiration.

business_rules.name: AI proposal writeback
business_rules.description: AI output affecting governed records is stored as a proposal until required approval succeeds.
business_rules.inputs: agent action; target object; automation policy

business_rules.name: Locked baseline protection
business_rules.description: A locked record version cannot be modified in place.
business_rules.action: Create change request and successor version

business_rules.name: External sharing minimum
business_rules.description: External users receive only explicitly shared objects and approved portal actions.
business_rules.action: Evaluate explicit share and portal permission

business_rules.name: Entitlement enforcement
business_rules.description: A disabled or expired entitlement blocks new use but retains governed historical data.
